Dear Parents,
Due to the forecasted air quality (Very Poor, AQI 312), the school has modified today's schedule for student safety. Morning Assembly will be held indoors over the PA system. The Class 7 PE period has been rescheduled to 13:30 when the air is expected to improve (Moderate, AQI 198). All students with asthma will be kept indoors during recess. Thank you for your cooperation.
